text.tspan: STANDARDIZED REGIONAL AVERAGE TURNED UP AS NY AND KANSAS
STRENGTHENED, RICHMOND IMPROVED, DALLAS STEADIED, AND
PHILLY’S INTERNALS STAYED FIRM; BREADTH FAVORS AN ISM PRINT
* STANDARDIZED AVERAGE OF THE FEDERAL RESERVE MANUFACTURING INDEXES FROM NEW YORK,
